fields.label: Token
fields.description: The unguessable part of the link. Generated by the server and never chosen: this is the only thing standing between a public URL and one party's negotiated prices.

fields.label: Catalogue
fields.description: What is shown. Only a catalogue marked as a showcase can be shared - an ordinary catalogue is an internal list and was never written to be read by a customer.

fields.label: Shared With
fields.description: Whose prices it shows. A link is always for one party - there is no such thing as a general price.

fields.label: Shared By
fields.description: The rep who sent it. A self-order off this link arrives as their draft, because it is their customer and their call to make.

fields.label: Season
fields.description: Where the link is for a season's showcase. Blank is an ordinary range share.

fields.label: Price List
fields.description: Resolved when the link is made and then fixed. A party reading a price on Tuesday and being quoted another on Wednesday is the argument this field exists to prevent.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Switched off, the link stops working at once. This is how a link sent to the wrong person is withdrawn - there is no other way to take a URL back.

fields.label: Valid To
fields.description: A share link is a quotation with a public URL, and a quotation that never expires is a price somebody holds you to next year. Blank means the server's own default.

fields.label: Maximum Opens
fields.description: Zero means no limit. A link forwarded around a market is still one link, and this is the only thing that notices.

fields.label: Last Seen From
fields.description: The address the last open came from. Kept so a link that has clearly been forwarded can be recognised and withdrawn, and for nothing else.
